AI costs

The AI bill, measured

One agent, per month, at Anthropic’s September 12, 2026 rates. We take no cut.

$140 a month

$1 to $2

a month at Economy, or $2 to $5 at Balanced

$21 to $42

a month at Economy, or $22 to $41 at Balanced

$64 to $132

a month at Economy, or $69 to $139 at Balanced

An estimate. Besides message count, two things move it: sending in sittings or spread across the day, and the quality setting.

Where the bill goes:

  • Your messages: two thirds to nine tenths.
  • Scheduled routines: a tenth to a third. A dozen add-ons with routines on fire about 320 times a month.
  • Mail it reads: under a tenth, and the one part that carries on when you stop.

Watching one inbox of about 30 emails a day costs $0.69 to $1.10 a month at Economy, or $3.73 to $6.43 at Balanced with draft replies on.

Connections add cost: each is described on every reply, so the same question costs about 2.8 times as much on a fully connected agent as on a bare one.

The full table, the inbox watch, and how we know
Measured monthly AI cost for one agent, at three levels of use and two response-quality settings.
How hard you work it What it’s connected to Messages sent a day Emails a day Per month at Economy Per month at Balanced
Light A calendar and a folder of documents about 6 none $1 to $2 $2 to $5
Moderate Calendar, email, a to-do list, and its own lists of people and projects about 25 about 80 $21 to $42 $22 to $41
Heavy All of those, plus about as many connections again about 70 about 200 $64 to $132 $69 to $139

Measured over a 30-day month. The top of each range assumes every reply starts from nothing, so a real month should land inside it.

The moderate row is one agent measured twice. Its add-ons pick Balanced themselves, so the dial moved only the inbox watch, and the Economy run pulled a bigger inbox, so its top end sits a dollar higher.

Best, the third quality setting, costs more and was not measured. A shared Archie for Business agent answers a whole team on one bill.

Monthly cost of the inbox watch alone, by how many emails reach the agent.
Emails reaching your agent At Economy At Balanced At Balanced, writing drafts
30 a day $0.69 to $1.10 $1.39 to $2.20 $3.73 to $6.43
80 a day $1.85 to $2.93 $3.70 to $5.86 $9.94 to $17.14
200 a day $4.62 to $7.32 $9.24 to $14.64 $24.84 to $42.84

Already inside the totals above.

Draft replies roughly triple it: a reply is a few hundred words of output, and output bills at 5x reading. The switch is on the Email panel.

The quality dial matters most on a simple agent

An add-on can pick its own quality and ignore the dial, and most capable ones do. So the dial is the whole difference between $1 and $5 on the light row, and under a tenth on the heavy row.

The checkbox under the dial, “Use this for every skill”, overrides the add-ons: on an agent with 12 add-ons, it took about two thirds off the monthly cost.

Measured

The figures. Five test runs in August 2026: four agent shapes, both quality settings, eight scripted turns each, on a real Anthropic key, calendar and inbox, with every call’s bill read back.

Measured

The prices. Anthropic’s own price sheet, read on September 12, 2026.

Checked

The arithmetic. One equation, kept with the Archie code. In September 2026 it matched every billed request to the cent on two of our own agents: 346 calls over two weeks on Claude, and 770 over three weeks on another company’s models.

Measured

How much the model thinks before answering, billed at 5x reading: 6% to 9% of a message that starts a conversation, 39% to 50% of one sent mid-conversation.

Assumed

How you space your messages, the biggest factor. A message right after the last costs about a sixth of one sent hours later, on every agent we measured, but a quarter of quick follow-ups on one agent paid full price. Plan on the upper end.

Assumed

Messages a day, how often routines run, and how much mail arrives. Mail is the widest: 30, 80 and 200 a day bracket what one real inbox did over two days.

Ongoing

We keep working on what a reply costs, and we do not publish how. Nobody here earns anything from this bill, and you should not pay more for a reply than it has to cost.

A change reaches these figures only after it has been measured.

One reply from a fully loaded agent is $0.01 right after another and up to $0.11 from nothing, at Balanced. Handing work to a specialist or using the Deep setting costs more.

Rented agents bill $0.04 to $0.10 an actionSource 1Source 2 or $2 a conversationSource 2, from their own price lists. An action is a different size of work from a reply. See them side by side →

Archie keeps a running total on the Account screen, by AI company and by agent. It is an estimate, and the screen says so.

The real bill is on your AI company’s own dashboard.
